group_assessment.weighting: PubMed ESearch on 2026-08-10 for exact senior author Aqeilan RI returned 137 records total and 64 with WWOX in title/abstract; exact first author Abu-Remaileh M returned 81 total and 11 with WWOX. This is an experienced WWOX experimental group, so execution and target knowledge receive high weight. It is not a primary WOREE clinical group, and the paper's word 'autonomous' still receives no uplift beyond the conditional-deletion, local-uptake and C2C12 evidence actually shown. Group investment strengthens technical familiarity but makes independent replication especially important for interpretation.

field_density.note: WWOX-metabolism is now a visible field, but the exact skeletal-muscle intersection is two records and the exact AMPK intersection one. This paper is therefore unusually load-bearing for muscle autonomy and needs stronger-than-usual boundary discipline.

multihop.note: All 54 references were enumerated. Fifteen are WWOX-direct. Thirteen resolve in a structured registry or research surface. The Chang 2007 review (10.1016/j.molmed.2006.11.006) and the original WWOX-p73 paper (10.1073/pnas.0400805101) occur only in the non-evidentiary seed corpus and are not load-bearing for the tissue-autonomy conclusion, so they were declared but not turned into new full-text debt. References 15 and 32 are the load-bearing mechanistic sources; this reading does not substitute for reading them.

corpus_crossquery.query: Where does PMID 30755385 already occur, which current claim does its muscle-specific evidence touch, and does the repository already state the tissue-of-measurement versus tissue-of-necessity inference verbatim?
corpus_crossquery.note: The PMID occurs in CORPUS-STUB-039, LIT-0063, meta_metabolism_current and FT-047. It was already labelled a core metabolic paper despite remaining a placeholder without a receipt. Horizontal comparison touches CLAIM 009 and DL-MECH-020, but no tracked markdown file contains the operator's exact inference wording. The paper supplies a direct example: muscle perturbation produces blood and whole-body endpoints, while the local FDG and C2C12 results prevent the causal tissue from being inferred solely from the measurement compartment.

entries.proposition: Only skeletal-muscle Wwox deletion among the three tested tissue deletions impaired glucose clearance.
entries.snippet: Likewise, only mice that lost WWOX in the muscle were defective in their ability to clear glucose, as determined by the glucose tolerance test (GTT)
entries.anchor: Results 2.1, final comparison sentence before Figure 1I

entries.proposition: The authors interpret the muscle result as essential for whole-organism glucose homeostasis.
entries.snippet: These data indicate that WWOX expression in SKM is essential for organismal glucose homeostasis.

entries.proposition: The paper explicitly claims a local autonomous defect in skeletal-muscle glucose uptake.
entries.snippet: These data suggest an autonomous defect in glucose uptake in SKM in the absence of WWOX.
entries.anchor: Results 2.2, final sentence after gastrocnemius and hamstring FDG results

entries.proposition: Acute Wwox depletion in a muscle cell line reproduces reduced AMPK phosphorylation.
entries.snippet: p-AMPK is decreased upon acute WWOX depletion, consistent with a possible role of WWOX in directly regulating AMPK activation.

entries.proposition: Endogenous WWOX and phosphorylated AMPK associate in C2C12 cells.
entries.snippet: Moreover, we detected specific endogenous WWOX and p-AMPK protein interaction in C2C12 muscle cells

entries.proposition: Negative liver and adipocyte findings do not exclude functions in untested pathways or nutrient states.
entries.snippet: Although WWOX inactivation in liver and adipocytes did not reveal a defect in glucose homeostasis and body weight regulation, this does not exclude a function of WWOX in other metabolic pathways or nutrient states, which were not addressed in this study.

entries.proposition: The reported inferential test was a Student t-test with a conventional significance threshold.
entries.snippet: Student's t-test was used to compare the values of the test and control samples. P < 0.05 indicates a significant difference.

entries.proposition: The main visual evidence shows reduced FDG uptake in two skeletal muscles of WwoxΔSKM animals.
entries.snippet: Panels I and J show lower knockout FDG curves in gastrocnemius and hamstring with displayed significance brackets.
entries.anchor: Figure 2, panels I and J, inspected at original downloaded pixel dimensions

entries.proposition: The cell-line experiment visually supports an acute cell-intrinsic AMPK/ACC phosphorylation component.
entries.snippet: Panels C and D show WWOX knockdown accompanied by lower pAMPK-to-AMPK and pACC-to-ACC quantification.
entries.anchor: Figure 4, panels C and D, inspected at original downloaded pixel dimensions
